title: Constructive Lean 4 Formalization and Exact-Rational Certificates for Polynomial-Time 1/5-Approximate Nash Equilibria
abstract: Google Research Cogentic (Nov. 25, 2026) introduced MaximinKiteNE, a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm computing an exact rational 1/5-approximate Nash equilibrium (delta = 0) in any [0,1]-normalized rational bimatrix game, breaking the 1/3 + delta barrier. We deliver an open, zero-dependency, zero-floating-point verification stack pairing: (i) MaximinKiteNash.lean, 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (zero sorry, zero axiom, zero Classical.choice, kernel axioms strictly [propext, Quot.sound]) mechanizing the s-kite best-response mixing, 7/4 welfare cap, zero-sum minimax screen, simplex rounding, low-gate square completion, shifted-cubic negativity, high-gate breakpoint ordering, and -1/3000 < -2^{-14} contradiction pillars; and (ii) KITE-NASH-CERT-1.0, a pure-stdlib Python Fraction auditor across four modes. We certify 16 canonical witnesses in 0.104-2.564 ms, independently verify H(z, c1, c2) <= -1/1280 <= -1/3000 across a 13^3 = 2,197-point exact rational grid on [1/4, 4]^3, reject 60/60 live adversarial forgeries plus raw IEEE-754/NaN/duplicate-key tokens, and enforce a 40-file SHA-256 manifest.
